Frequently asked questions

How many Software Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 6,092 open Software Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do Software Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $126,500–$192,040 a year, based on 997 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Software Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include Oracle (655 listings), Coinbase (177 listings), Highmark Health (161 listings), Meta (122 listings), and SpaceX (122 listings).

Do any Software Engineer jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

2 listings mention visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Are there entry-level Software Engineer jobs in the United States?

132 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.
